summary:
Wix is the website builder at wix.com. The “W” mark in the tab is the icon for Wix’s own site, not the favicon a customer published on their Wix site.

Checked 12 November 2026 against wix.com. HTML came from https://www.wix.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 192x192 → https://www.wix.com/favicon.ico; shortcut icon → https://www.wix.com/favicon.ico; apple-touch-icon → https://www.wix.com/favicon.ico; mask-icon → https://www.wix.com/favicon.ico.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.wix.com/favicon.ico returned png (192×192, 3477 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.wix.com/favicon.ico, measured at 192×192 png.

Brand colour #000000 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-192x192-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-192x192-01.png at 192×192 (png, 3477 bytes) from https://www.wix.com/favicon.ico.
